write_up: Your resume makes a strong case for outpatient orthopedic physical therapy! At North Loop Sports Rehab, you show the patients you treat, the program you built, and the therapists you mentor. A recruiter can quickly see both your clinical work and your senior responsibilities.
The return-to-run line is a great model: it names what you built and how many patients completed it. Your Minnesota license and outpatient specialties are easy to find, too.
The main detail to add is how you measured the improvement in discharged patients' function. Your resume is unlikely to be what holds you back; how competitive a role is will matter too.
